title: Withdraw subject-bearing service and WebSocket logs
scope: Bounded W07 future-write containment in OptimizelyService, EventDispatcher, sceneGen and PersonalizationWebSocket: remove subject/result success logs, replace raw error/body/callback/type/destination logs with fixed labels (numeric scene status permitted), and stop reading unsuccessful model bodies only for logging. Preserve domain delivery, SDK thresholds and callback distinctions, public response/fallback, queue/socket/storage and deterministic decision behavior.
non_goals: No scoring/ledger/auth/consent/business delivery or retry policy changes, socket ownership fix, new telemetry pipeline, package upgrades, new runtime infrastructure or broad matrix.

Other route/scheduled/service logs, public error response contents, permitted schema/access/retention, datasets and historic data obligations remain open. No full W07/finding/privacy/customer/SLO/deployed/release acceptance; targeted current regression does not reclose prior full W34.01/W07.01 contracts.
No real network, cloud/deploy/provision/seed/credentials/customer-data operations, operational scripts, staging/commit/push, cleanup or unrelated edits.

criteria.description: Actual four modules do not log raw subject/result/error/body/type/destination content in scoped paths or coerce hostile SDK callback objects. Both Optimizely logger thresholds and missing-datafile distinction survive; ordinary event delivery and fresh no-op remain distinct. Dispatcher results/full payload/retry/normal queue and caught errors, scene cache/model/R2/fallback effects and socket direct callback/send/storage/state effects are preserved.

Unchanged existing telemetry and consent/service controls retain eight-writer withdrawal, route effects and OFF-only deterministic decisions; five selected actual-workerd entry/queue cases preserve log containment and ack/retry behavior. This is bounded current regression, not prior full-contract reclosure or native WebSocket/external acceptance.

Independent actual frozen source/baseline/assertion/evidence review and K1/K2 reruns plus inspected application noEmit, scoped diff and relevant artifact identity confirm bounded production changes and explicit limits; separate lead disposition records handoff.
